item.title: Calera authorities respond to CSX train derailment blocking two crossings
item.description: Emergency crews worked overnight after a CSX train derailed near Sysco Foods.The Calera Fire and Police Departments responded to the scene at County Road 22 around 3 a.m. The crossings at 22 and County Road 84 were blocked.According to local reports, at least six cars left the tracks. The cause is unknown, and no injuries were reported.Calera Fire said crews were working to remove the cars and reopen the crossings. item.title: Sean Dietrich: A peace of my mind
item.description: We lit the peace candle for Advent a few nights ago.My wife and I read aloud from our little Episcopal book, standing before our Advent candles, using solemn voices.
